column3: The Hebrew says “when I came”; NASB has “when He came,” following some manuscripts.
“Corpses of kings” may also mean “memorial stones”; “high places” is read by some as “at their death.”
“Declare the house” is rendered “describe the temple,” and “measure the plan” follows a difficult word.
“Holy place of holy places” is rendered “most holy.”
“The priests the Levites” is rendered “the Levitical priests.”
“Someone will burn it” is rendered “it shall be burned.”
